raw_extract:
Pour vous inscrire dans un établissement d'enseignement supérieur, vous devez payer des droits d'inscription ainsi qu'une cotisation vie étudiante et de campus (CVEC). Pour l'année universitaire 2026-2027, la CVEC s'élève à 105 €.
À savoir  Les étudiants boursiers sont exonérés des droits d'inscription et de la CVEC.
research_notes: CONFIRMED from the French government's service portal (published 21 August 2026). France mandatory fee, stated SEPARATELY from tuition as the corpus requires: the CVEC (cotisation vie étudiante et de campus / Contribution vie étudiante et de campus) is EUR 105 PER YEAR for academic year 2026-2027. This is a national mandatory contribution paid to the CROUS alongside tuition, and it applies to non-EU international students too. CONFIRMED EXEMPTION relevant to scholarship holders: scholarship students (étudiants boursiers) are exempt from both the tuition fees and the CVEC — directly material for a scholarship corpus. CORROBORATION FROM A UNIVERSITY PAGE: Sorbonne Université's own fee page states the same mechanism — 'Tout étudiant qui s'inscrit en formation initiale à l'université doit, au préalable, acquitter une taxe annuelle obligatoire auprès du CROUS, la CVEC, Contribution à la vie étudiante et de campus' — confirming CVEC is an annual mandatory university-enrolment tax, though the Sorbonne page does not restate the amount. GAP: the Sorbonne page does not state the CVEC amount, so the 105 EUR figure rests on the government portal only; I did not fetch etudiant.gouv.fr's MESR table to double-confirm the amount.

claims.statement: To enrol in a higher education institution you must pay tuition fees as well as the student and campus life contribution (CVEC); for the 2026-2027 academic year the CVEC amounts to 105 €.
Scholarship students (étudiants boursiers) are exempt from both the tuition fees and the CVEC.
claims.unit: EUR per year (exempt for scholarship holders)
